tools.name: World Time Buddy
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the World Time Buddy homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: World Time Buddy is a versatile time zone converter designed for developers and individuals who need to manage multiple time zones efficiently. It allows users to convert time across the world with ease, making it an essential tool for those working in global teams or managing international projects. Key features include a user-friendly interface, the ability to convert time for any date and time, and the option to add favorite time zones for quick access. It is also capable of showing the time difference between two time zones, which is particularly useful for scheduling meetings or coordinating tasks across different regions. World Time Buddy is suitable for a wide range of users, from freelancers to corporate teams, and is particularly beneficial for those who need to stay on top of time zone changes. Pros include its simplicity, accuracy, and the ability to handle a vast number of time zones. Limitations might include a lack of advanced features for more complex time management tasks, and it may not be as robust as some enterprise-level solutions.
